Conditional UpdateItem claim before ClickUp PUT; duplicate on retry/redelivery/reopen; tested with date_done null and present.
After a failed ClickUp update the claim stays pending (not reverted); expires after 5 min; takeover checks whether the due date moved. No DeleteItem.
ReturnValuesOnConditionCheckFailure=ALL_OLD to classify refusals.
IAM only GetItem and UpdateItem on the table; phase 5 adds PutItem itself.
Takeover double-completion hole: an earlier update that landed but whose done write failed can let a later takeover complete once more.
A definite ClickUp 4xx leaves the 5-min pending lockout (update_task raises the same ValueError for every error; helper needs to expose HTTP status).
A due date moved by hand while a failed claim is expired reads as a landed update.
Lost response on the done write logs a misleading 'claim expired' line.
Phase 5: failure reply should say to wait 5 minutes.
